releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 290: Private Locker controls remain on the PIN screen. Select a control, enter the Locker PIN, then tap PIN Verify Karke Kaam Karein to run the selected action. Other Diary and Note locks unchanged.
